goals: Maintain the curated Fabric-only port of Building But Better 2.0pre4 for Minecraft Java 26.2 without redistributing upstream All Rights Reserved resources.
Preserve the retained building families and their original stateful behavior through an explicit, testable registry and resource-closure contract.
Provide Veiled, Celestial, and Murublight as explicit optional Enderscape-backed complete BBB wood families without changing standalone BBB or inferring families from registry names.
scope: Maintain exactly 171 blocks and 172 items without Enderscape: the historical eleven wood families plus the Minecraft 26.2-native complete Pale Oak eleven-form family, seven stone families, braziers, rope, iron fence, and the Hammer.

When Enderscape 3.0.2 or newer provides the six exact audited source-plank and stripped axial blocks, append exactly three complete eleven-form Veiled, Celestial, and Murublight families—33 blocks and block items—for exact provider-present totals of 204 blocks and 205 items.

Maintain BBB-owned state-aware rope behavior: only vertical bbb:rope is climbable, and its non-sneaking main-hand interaction pays out or reels in exactly one bottom segment of its contiguous vertical column while preserving ordinary ChainBlock placement and breaking.

Preserve the retained rotation, waterlogging, connectivity, collision, lighting, Hammer, lattice-plant, urn, model, texture, tag, language, recipe, advancement, loot, and drop contracts implemented by legacy source 4ddbd2a7b39cb33653f9ddacf9bca0a419cc500d and finalized at legacy branch head 08cba03bc6b19d43a484e7500ca8b366a254e671.

Preserve the accepted dev.6 resource closure byte-for-byte as the hash-verified standalone input, and generate the optional Enderscape closure from the exact audited 3.0.2+mc26.2 provider only in ignored local build output.

exclusions: BBB layers, BBB ladders (including Pale Oak Layer and Ladder), the small-stone-block system, Chisel and related removed tools, and any silently restored registry content.
Inventory Bridge Framework changes, Clutter No More changes, or unrelated compatibility implementation.

Raw upstream BBB or Enderscape models, textures, recipes, data, translations, loot tables, tags, classes, or other protected content in tracked source or redistributed combined development JARs; ARR-derived generated closure is confined to ignored build output and the ignored locally retained artifact.
Architectury and MidnightLib dependencies removed by the direct Fabric port.
Runtime deployment, Test Slot or Test Instance Manager changes, accepted-stack mutation, dedicated Workbench access, and protected gameplay-profile access during this migration.
